The '''Wyrmscraig goat''' is a [[hunter creature]] found on [[Wyrmscraig]], requiring level 60 [[Hunter]] and completion of the [[Sheep Herder]] quest to catch. A [[cattleprod]], the [[Telekinetic Grab]] spell, or the [[Dark Lure]] spell are needed to move them to the [[goat pit]] as part of the [[goat hunting]] activity.

Attempting to prod a goat unarmed will fail and display the message {{Mes|You should use a cattleprod if you want to prod the goats.}}. Attempting to prod a goat with anything equipped that is not a cattleprod will also fail and display the message {{Mes|You don't think your current weapon would work as a cattleprod.}}

==Trivia==
* Wyrmscraig goats can be prodded all the way to the gankplank on [[Wyrmscraig]], where if your boat is present and visible, it will board the boat as a passenger with the dialogue "The goat takes position on the gangplank, ready to board your boat." You can then sail around with the goat, and it will follow you off when disembarking. If you disembark anywhere but at [[Port Sarim]], the message {{mes|The goat disembarks with you, but doesn't look happy here. Maybe you should take one somewhere else.}} will be displayed.
** If you disembark with the goat at Port Sarim, the messages {{mes|The goat disembarks with you and is overjoyed to be on the mainland!}} and {{mes|This is what sailing is all about.}} are displayed, and the player receives 1,000 [[Sailing]] experience as a reward. This is affected by the [[horizon's lure]] experience boost. Bringing more goats to Port Sarim will only result in the first "overjoyed" message, with no Sailing experience being rewarded.
** The goat can be found roaming around the mainland afterwards, functioning similarly to [[Bob the Cat]] where it has a large wander radius and tends to get stuck in places like the [[Wise Old Man]]'s house, or the smithy by [[Varrock west bank]]. The goat can be in different locations on each world, and it cannot be prodded or moved around with spells.
